title: Top 5 Causes of Spinal Cord Injuries in Los Angeles - NewsBreak
text:
7 hours ago
Spinal cord injuries result from trauma to the spinal cord leading to disrupted communication between the body and the brain. These injuries are likely to cause future health problems such as paralysis, chronic pain, and immobility.
Serious accidents are among the major causes of spinal cord injuries in big cities such as Los Angeles. As one of the most populated cities in California, it has some of the busiest roads in the United States. The high traffic volume, large construction projects, and active outdoor activities are some of the reasons why serious accidents are likely to happen in this region.
When victims are subjected to these injuries, they seek a spinal injury attorney in Los Angeles, CA , to understand their rights and legal options.
Motor Vehicle Accidents Car accidents are the most common cause of spinal cord injuries in the United States. This is particularly true for high-impact collisions, where fractures and compression may result in permanent spinal cord injuries.
The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has reported that traffic collisions continue to be a significant cause of serious injuries in the country. You may find crash data from the NHTSA database on road safety.
Some of the most common motor vehicle accidents that may cause spinal cord injuries are:
High-speed rear-end collisions Crashes with trucks and other commercial vehicles Motorcycle collisions Rollover accidents Pedestrian and bicycle collisions The most accident-prone roads in the country are Interstate 405 and Interstate 10.
Slip and Fall Accidents Falls are another major cause of spinal cord injuries. Falls are common among elderly people. Sudden falls cause severe trauma to the neck or spine. Falls are one of the most common causes of serious injuries in the US.
Slip and fall accidents are common in the following:
Grocery stores Apartments Hotels and restaurants Office buildings Sidewalks Hazards such as slippery floors, broken stairs, or poor lighting can lead to such accidents.
Violent Incidents Violence is another cause of spinal cord injuries. Gunshot wounds, physical assaults, and other forms of violence are some causes of such injuries.
These sudden injuries result in paralysis or nerve damage. Some places experience high rates of such injuries due to high population density and high crime rates. Luckily, some of these emergency trauma cases are surgically treated.
Sports and Recreational Activities Los Angeles provides opportunities for surfing, skateboarding, and contact sports. Though these are popular recreational activities, they can result in serious injuries.
Spinal cord injuries that result from sports can occur in:
Diving accidents Football and rugby injuries Extreme sports like skateboarding Mountain biking accidents Gymnastics injuries Young adults and teenagers are at high risk of suffering from these types of accidents.
Key Takeaways A spinal cord injury happens when trauma disrupts messages sent through the spinal cord. The most common cause of spinal cord injuries is motor vehicle accidents. Falls, especially slip and falls, are another common cause of spinal cord injuries. Violent crimes and assaults may cause severe spinal cord injuries. Sports and recreational activities may cause spinal cord injuries.
